posts.description: Fall is just around the corner, and that means it’s time for our favorite tradition of the year! Join us at The Red Barn Farm in Redmond, WA for our 8th Annual Fall Festival, a family-friendly celebration full of autumn charm, exciting activities, and memories waiting to be made. When: Every October weekend: Saturdays & Sundays! Where: 5703 208th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98053 Duration: 3 Hours | Last entry at 3:00 PM (activities end at 4 PM) Ticket Pricing Adults: $12 Children (Ages 1–17): $20 (includes 1 feed bag to feed the animals!) Infants (Under 1): Free Add-Ons U-Pick Flowers: $25-35 (includes vase + fill it with flowers of your choice) U-Pick Pumpkins: Traditional varieties at $0.58/lb | Specialty varieties at $0.89/lb Extra Feed Bags: can be purchased on site with all proceeds donated to our non-profit Gem Mining: This year, our nonprofit is excited to host a gem mining fundraiser! Discover crystals, shark teeth, fossils, gems, and more at this activity booth! Tickets (in the form of donations) will be available for purchase on-site. posts.title: Pup-kin Patch at the Pumpkin Farm and Puzzle Patch
posts.headline: Bellevue · 星期日亲子精选
posts.bannerText: 一起发现身边的小惊喜！
highlights: 🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Calling all farm dogs! We’re pet friendly all season long, but for one special Sunday, we’re making the day all about our four-legged visitors. Bring your pup along for a fall day at the farm – wander the sunflower field, explore the corn maze, pick the perfect pumpkin, play yard games, snap some adorable fall photos, and enjoy the patch together. Pup-kin Patch includes: • Dog-friendly fun throughout the farm • Fall photo opportunities with your pup • 10-acre corn maze with 3 trails + game • 7-acre sunflower field + winding sunflower walk • U-pick pumpkins, squash + gourds • U-pick flowers while available • Yard games • A small selection of local vendors • Free parking • All-day re-entry Admission: Our regular reduced 2026 fall admission — no additional charge for Pup-kin Patch! Dogs must remain leashed and under their owner’s supervision while visiting the farm. Woodinville, WA Sunday, October 18 9 AM–7 PM Grab the leash, pick out their best fall bandana, and bring your favorite little pumpkin to the Pup-kin Patch.

posts.title: Discovering Defiance: Drop-in Hikes at Point Defiance
posts.headline: Tacoma · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 公园向导带队的休闲徒步，约3英里，可按兴趣调整路线，免费且无需报名。亲子可参加（需成人陪同），但路况有岩石和坡度，部分孩子或觉得路程偏长；拴绳宠物犬可同走。请自备饮水、零食与适当着装。
posts.description: Hike with a Park Guide every Saturday starting from the Rhododendron Garden at 9 am. The walk will average 3 miles at a leisurely pace and can be tailored to participant interest and time for a different route each week. Free. No registration necessary. Participants should come prepared with water, snacks, appropriate attire for the weather, and any questions they may have for the Park Guide. Kids are welcome if accompanied by an adult. Please note the hike may be too long (up to 3 miles) for some children. Well-behaved dogs on leash are allowed. Hikers will navigate uneven, rocky and hilly trails. Image sourced from event website.
posts.caption:

posts.description: Named Washington State’s best pumpkin patch by “Readers Digest” in 2019, and more recently among the best pumpkin farms in the country (!), this farm is justifiably very popular, especially with younger kids. As the Snohomish Valley’s Original Pumpkin Patch, Craven Farm is a decades old tradition for many families. Continue your family tradition or start a new one this fall at Craven Farm! At Craven Farm, we’re dedicated to creating an enjoyable and memorable fall experience for everyone who visits us. Our farm offers an extensive range of activities to suit all age groups, including apple cannons and slingers, fair foods, espresso, and donuts. Our unique attractions like cow trains, wagon rides, multiple acres of themed corn mazes, jump pad & animals are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Visit us today and make some unforgettable memories with us this fall! Check out our huge list of pumpkin extravaganzas happening this year.
